friendly_name: Feedback slash command and input hardening
purpose_context: The in-harness feedback survey only appears on throttled triggers, and its free-text validation is minimal. This mission adds an on-demand slash command rendered through the harness question UI, and hardens rating, comment and email validation in one shared validator used by every flow, including a visible 2000-character comment limit shown before the user types.
purpose_tldr: Users open the feedback form on demand with /spec-kitty.feedback, and every answer is validated and sanitized before anything is sent.
